C1011.title: EVE Online Faces Threats from Gold Farming Groups and RMT
C1011.summary: Academic research highlights that the MMORPG EVE Online continues to face threats from gold farming groups and real-money trading (RMT). These activities, identified through an anomaly detection framework, undermine the in-game economic balance and fair competitive environment.
